text: dsh-ui-picker 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的前端界面控件拾取插件。它通过本机 HTTP 桥接服务连接正在开发的网页和 DSH 输入框：在网页中点选控件后，会整理标签、文本、属性、组件名、CSS 选择器、XPath、尺寸和样式，再把描述插入当前会话。支持单个控件即时发送，也支持 Shift 多选后批量发送，并提供悬浮按钮、悬停高亮及连接失败时复制文本的后备方式。适合需要让 DSH 根据页面中的具体控件修改界面的前端开发者。默认使用本机 127.0.0.1:17857 桥接，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-ui-picker sends page controls to the DSH composer with text, component, CSS selector, XPath, size, and styles. Pick one control or batch several with Shift. Hover highlighting and clipboard fallback are supported. The local bridge defaults to 127.0.0.1:17857; no API key is needed.
想让 DSH 根据网页里的某个按钮或输入框帮我改界面。
有没有办法把页面控件的 CSS 定位信息直接放进 DSH 对话？
我不清楚元素选择器，想点一下控件就把它的结构告诉 AI。
让 DSH 一次收到页面上几个控件的描述，方便一起调整样式。
I want to select a page control and send its details to my DSH session.
How can I give DSH a CSS selector and component details without using DevTools?
Help me collect several UI elements from a webpage and describe them in one request.
I want selected element information inserted into the current DSH composer automatically.
dsh-ui-picker 的功能「控件详情采集」：在网页拾取模式中点击一个界面元素，会整理它的标签、文本、属性、CSS 选择器、XPath、组件信息、尺寸和样式，并生成可供 DSH 使用的描述。
dsh-ui-picker 的功能「多控件批选」：按住 Shift 点击可把多个页面控件加入一批，按 Enter 或发送按钮后会将它们编号整理成一条描述并发送；Esc 可取消本次选择。
dsh-ui-picker 的功能「桥接到会话」：页面端将控件描述 POST 到本机桥接，DSH 网页客户端通过轮询获取新内容，并通过输入框接口插入当前会话；无法发送时页面端会尝试复制文本。
dsh-ui-picker 的功能「悬停定位」：开启拾取后，移动鼠标会在目标控件周围显示定位反馈，点击即可选中；可通过浮动按钮或 Ctrl+Shift+P 开关拾取模式。
dsh-ui-picker 使用本机 127.0.0.1 桥接页面和 DSH：被选控件的描述及页面标题、URL 会发送到该本机服务，再进入 DSH 会话。

dsh-ui-picker README · 为什么需要它：非前端同学描述界面问题时，只能说出「那个蓝色的按钮」「右边那个卡片」；
而 AI 改 UI 需要的是 `#submit-order`、`//*[@id="submit-order"]`、`.btn.btn-primary`。
中间这层翻译，现在由一次点击完成。

dsh-ui-picker README · 工作方式：- **宿主侧**（`index.js`）：在 `127.0.0.1:17857` 起一个只监听本机的迷你 HTTP 服务，
  接收控件描述、提供长轮询，同时把 `picker.js` 当静态文件发出去。
- **客户端侧**（`client.js`）：DSH 网页里运行，轮询桥接服务，通过输入框 facade
  （`captureInsertion` + `insertText`）把文本插到光标处。**不渲染任何可见 UI**。
- **页面侧**（`picker.js`）：在你自己的页面里运行，负责悬停高亮、点选、采集信息。

桥接服务刻意不复用 DSH 自己的端口和鉴权：任意网页（不同源）拿不到 DSH 的会话 cookie，
独立回环端口最简单可靠。它只传文本，不执行代码、不读写文件。

dsh-ui-picker README · 特性：- **一次点击拿到全部定位信息**：标签 / id / class / role / 文案 / placeholder / aria-label、
  CSS 选择器、绝对 XPath、父级链、尺寸位置、关键计算样式
- **组件识别**：自动探测 React（fiber）、Vue 2/3 组件名，以及 Element / Ant Design / Vant / MUI 等库的类名
- **多选**：`Shift` 加选，底部面板显示已选数量，`Enter` 一次性发送成编号清单
- **可拖动的悬浮按钮**：玻璃拟态取景框图标，位置按站点记忆，右键还原；支持深色模式
- **零侵入**：不改变页面布局、不污染 DOM 结构；DSH 侧也没有任何可见 UI
- **兜底**：桥接没起来时自动复制到剪贴板，并给出提示
- **Shadow DOM / 同源 iframe**：能穿透 shadow root，也能钩住同源 iframe

dsh-ui-picker README · dsh-ui-picker：A UI-editing helper for people who don't live in DevTools. You don't need to know what a
CSS selector, DOM node or class name is. Click the element on the page and its full technical
identity — tag, selector, XPath, component name, computed styles — is written straight into the
**DeepSeek Harness** composer. Then just say "make it a rounded blue button" and the model edits
the right element.

---

dsh-ui-picker README · Why：When a non-frontend teammate reports "that blue button on the right", an AI needs
`#submit-order`, `//*[@id="submit-order"]`, `.btn.btn-primary` to act. This tool is that
translation layer, compressed into one click.

dsh-ui-picker README · How it works：```
Your page under development              DSH Web GUI
┌──────────────────┐   POST /push      ┌───────────────────────────────┐
│ picker.js        │ ─────────────────▶│ bridge 127.0.0.1:17857        │
│ pick → describe  │                   │        │ long-poll            │

dsh-ui-picker README · How it works：- **Host half** (`index.js`): a loopback-only HTTP bridge on `127.0.0.1:17857` that receives
  descriptions, serves long-polling, and also serves `picker.js` as a static asset.
- **Client half** (`client.js`): runs inside the DSH web client, polls the bridge and inserts
  the text at the caret through the composer facade (`captureInsertion` + `insertText`).
  It renders **no visible UI**.
- **Page half** (`picker.js`): runs in your page — hover outline, element picking, description.

dsh-ui-picker README · How it works：The bridge deliberately does *not* reuse DSH's own port or auth: arbitrary pages are
cross-origin and cannot hold DSH session cookies. A dedicated loopback port is the simplest
reliable channel. It carries text only — no code execution, no file access.

dsh-ui-picker README · Features：- **One click, full identity**: tag / id / class / role / text / placeholder / aria-label,
  CSS selector, absolute XPath, ancestor chain, box size & position, key computed styles
- **Component awareness**: detects React (fiber), Vue 2/3 component names, plus
  Element / Ant Design / Vant / MUI class prefixes
- **Multi-select**: `Shift`-click to add, a bottom panel shows the count, `Enter` sends them
  as one numbered list
- **Draggable floating button**: glass-morphism viewfinder icon, position remembered per site,
  right-click to reset, dark-mode aware
- **Non-invasive**: no layout changes, no DOM pollution; nothing visible inside DSH either
- **Graceful fallback**: if the bridge is down, the description is copied to the clipboard
- **Shadow DOM & same-origin iframes** supported

dsh-ui-picker README · Usage：1. A small glass button appears at the bottom-right (or press `Ctrl + Shift + P`)
2. Click it — hovering any control draws a blue outline
3. Click the target — the description lands in the DSH composer
4. Append your request after `修改需求：` and hit Enter

dsh-ui-picker README · Multi-select：Hold `Shift` on the first pick to start a batch; afterwards click further controls directly.
A bottom panel shows **已选 N 个** (N selected):

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| `Enter` / **发送** | sends all picks as a single message |
| `Esc` / **取消** | discards the batch |

dsh-ui-picker README · Button gestures：| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Drag | moves the button; remembered per site in `localStorage`, clamped to the viewport |
| Right-click | resets to the bottom-right corner |
| Click | toggles pick mode |

`window.dshUiPicker.resetPosition()` does the same reset from code.

dsh-ui-picker README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| No floating button | `picker.js` didn't load — check Network for 200, and `window.dshUiPicker` in the console |
| "没连上 DSH" (bridge unreachable) | `curl http://127.0.0.1:17857/health`; make sure DSH was restarted |
| Text arrives nowhere | Composer facade changed — look for `[dsh-ui-picker]` warnings in the DSH console; the description is logged there for manual copy |
| Port already in use | `netstat -ano | findstr 17857`, free it or change the port |
| Button off-screen | Right-click it, or `window.dshUiPicker.resetPosition()` |
